behaviorChanges: ci-python and renderer-ci publish a run artifact named `evidence` containing JUnit XML (pytest + vitest); ci-python's aggregation job composes the run's single `evidence` artifact from every ci-python job (both matrix legs plus the fresh-install-smoke gate) so a matrix-leg or fresh-install failure renders as a `fail` result rather than green

optionalMigrations.description: Adopters can publish the same `evidence` run artifact from their own test jobs so their pipeline stages render real pass/fail counts on the CommandCenter dashboard instead of amber; the composer is .github/scripts/emit_evidence.py.

requiredMigrations.command: gh auth refresh --hostname github.com -s read:project -s project
requiredMigrations.description: Carried forward from 0.10.3 for lanes updating across it: grant the gh token the GitHub Projects scopes the fail-closed board gates need. Machines already on 0.10.3+ or whose token carries read:project and project need no action.

rollbackNotes: Pinning back to 0.10.11 stops the `evidence` artifact from being published; the CI gates and their pass/fail behavior are unchanged in either direction (the evidence surface is purely additive reporting). No on-disk state moves.
